body.name: checkable global capacity certificate
body.construction: \(\mathrm{Cert}=(\gamma_\epsilon,L_\epsilon,U_\epsilon,\{(I_r,\underline J_r,\overline J_r,m_r,\sigma_r)\}_{r=1}^R)\), with \(\sigma_r\in\{\mathrm{active},\mathrm{pruned}\}\), is a rational dyadic partition record. Each oracle receipt encloses \(J\) on \(I_r\); every pruned record satisfies \(\underline J_r>U_\epsilon\); the active intervals cover every global minimizer; the incumbent point receipt at \(\gamma_\epsilon\) has upper endpoint \(U_\epsilon\); and \(L_\epsilon=\min_{r:\sigma_r=\mathrm{active}}\underline J_r\) satisfies \(U_\epsilon-L_\epsilon\le\epsilon\).
